name: mcp-demo
description: TypeScript MCP server demo with auth (one-click register + GitHub OAuth), runnable over Streamable HTTP. Codex runs the integration test and prints the visit URL.

scripts.test:codex: codex exec --task "Run the integration test suite with `npm test` (or `npx vitest run`). The test boots the MCP demo server and MUST print the local visit URLs (web portal, GitHub OAuth login, and MCP endpoint) to stdout. Report those URLs verbatim to the user so they can open them in a browser."
